~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ fw1-ctxm FW context ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
changeto context {FW_context_name}
config terminal
!
!
object-group network VRF_{VRF_name}_Subnets
  network-object {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask}
!
access-list {VRF_name}_access_in extended permit ip {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} any
!
route {VRF_name} {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} {GW-VRFGLUE_IP} 1
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub1 FW context router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
ip route {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} {GW-FW_outside_IP} name {FW_context_name}:{Vlan_name}
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site02-hub1 FW context router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
ip route {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} {GW-FW_outside_IP} name {FW_context_name}:{Vlan_name}
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ vss-a25-l25 building router vss ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VRF START ########### 
!
ip vrf {VRF_name}
  rd 64000:{RD_ID}
  route-target export 64000:{RD_ID}
  route-target import 64000:{RD_ID}
!
router bgp 64000
  address-family ipv4 vrf {VRF_name}
    redistribute connected
    redistribute static
    no synchronization
        network 0.0.0.0
        exit-address-family
!
! ########### VRF END ############# 

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {Vlan_name}
!
interface Port-channel{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  description {Vlan_name}
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address {User_Prefix_last_IP} {User_prefix_netmask}
  no shutdown
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############

interface Port-channel{int_#}
